summary: IDS feed s110_single is degraded: 87.1% encrypted bytes exceeds IDS tolerance of 60%, severely limiting payload inspection and detection coverage.

findings.root_cause: 87% of bytes on this feed are encrypted (likely TLS) and are being forwarded as-is by the packet broker with no SSL visibility/decryption stage. IDS requires cleartext payload for signature and anomaly detection.
findings.impact_on_tool: IDS is blind to ~87% of payload bytes (threshold 60%). Cannot inspect encrypted sessions for exploits, malware, or C2, causing high false-negative rate and reduced detection coverage despite needing full payload and bidirectional flow.

recommended_fix.why: IDS needs full payload in cleartext to detect threats. Adding a packet-broker integrated SSL visibility/decryption (or feeding a decrypted copy / cleartext tap) will bring encrypted share below 60% tolerance and restore inspection without violating privacy policy via selective bypass.
